name: pangu
description: Apply pangu spacing to prose created or edited for your task, preserving code, exact text, and the requested editing scope.

interface.shortDescription: CJK prose spacing with code and exact text preserved
interface.longDescription: Apply pangu.js text rules as you write CJK-mixed replies, docs, comments, and commit messages. Space only the prose created or edited for the task, preserving code, markup, URLs, paths, and exact quotations. Follow the requested format and editing scope. All runtime rules are in one SKILL.md; Han, Japanese kana, and bopomofo are covered, while Hangul is unchanged.
defaultPrompt: 幫我檢查這段中英混排的文字，補上缺少的盤古之白。
之後產生中文內容時，都套用盤古之白的空格規則。
